research_findings: Reviewed `SESSION_PERSISTENCE.md` and codebase for offline session management.
Identified that while local storage persistence exists, there's no UI to view or manage saved sessions as noted in the future enhancements.
Analyzed Next.js App Router structure and navigation components.
features_improved: Updated main navigation menu to include a link to the new Sessions dashboard.
new_features_added: Created a dedicated Sessions Dashboard (`/sessions`) to view all offline practice drafts saved in local storage.
Implemented `SessionDashboard` component that displays storage info, lists saved sessions, allows deleting individual sessions, and provides a quick link to resume practice.
Added hydration checks to `SessionDashboard` to prevent React rendering errors before local storage is available.
next_steps_for_next_run: Add functionality to sync offline sessions to cloud storage for authenticated users.
